Future<void> once() async {
  for (var index = await loadStart(); index < 6; index++) {
    consume(index);
  }
  var index = 0;
  for (index = await loadStart(); index < 6; index++) consume(index);
  for ((await prepare()); index < 6; index++) consume(index);
  for (
    var rows = await loadRows(), cursor = 0;
    cursor < rows.length;
    cursor++
  ) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await save(rows[cursor]);
  }
  for (
    var left = await loadStart(), right = await loadEnd();
    left < right;
    left++
  ) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await save(left);
  }
}

Future<void> repeated(dynamic groups) async {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  for (var index = 0; await hasNext(); index++) consume(index);
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  for (var index = 0; index < 6; await advance()) consume(index);
  for (var index = await loadStart(); index < 6; index++) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    await save(index);
  }
  for (final group in groups) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    for (var index = await loadStart(group); index < 6; index++) consume(index);
  }
  for (var outer = 0; outer < 4; outer++) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
    for (var index = await loadStart(outer); index < 6; index++) consume(index);
  }
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  for (var index = 0; await hasNext(); index++, tick()) consume(index);
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  for (var index = 0; index < 6; index++, await advance()) consume(index);
}
